name: JavaScript (Node.js)
testGuide: Use node:test (import { test, before, after, mock } from "node:test") and node:assert/strict. Fake time with t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ["setTimeout"] }). Only Node built ins, no packages. TypeScript is run by Node with its types stripped, so only use erasable syntax: no enums, no namespaces, no parameter properties.
